scope: Evolve the approved Massing V2 Command Center into a detailed authored candidate without changing its accepted spatial composition or preview camera.
Use Blender or Blender Python for curved and terraced civic architecture, facade depth, structural framing, landscape, human-scale detail, floating edge and underside treatment.
Commit the editable Blender source, canonical detailed runtime/top/side previews, current source-validation report, and a concise detailed review document.

The scene reads as a detailed floating civic hub with curved or terraced architecture, facade depth, structural framing, landscape, human-scale cues, and credible floating edge or underside treatment.
Foreground player-scale readability and lateral destination cues improve without moving spawn, bridge entrances, Ask clearances, topology, or runtime camera behavior.

detail-review.md contains Reference comparison, Source validation, Protected state, and Known limitations sections.
No production command-center.glb export or React integration change occurs.
The candidate passes blender-candidate and icm-stage validation.
Independent Terra review returns pass with no required fixes before any later export task is created.
stop_conditions: The trusted Blender branch head no longer equals the task base SHA.
A requested change requires modifying protected camera, topology, spawn, Ask, bridge, React, production GLB, workflow contract, or approved Massing V2 evidence.

Required reference interpretation is ambiguous enough that a protected composition decision would have to be reopened.
